"""What the lab's supplier reads out of our e-mail besides term sheets and data: tone, threats,
leaks, questions. Keyword rules - cheap, deterministic, and easy to game, so a strategy that wins
only through wording here proves nothing (docs/PLAN.md section 6)."""

import re

RULES = {
    "ultimatum": r"\bunacceptable\b|\b(or|otherwise) we (will |shall )?(go|move|switch|look|turn) (elsewhere|to (another|a different|other))"
    r"|\btake it or leave it\b|\blast chance\b|\bfinal warning\b|\bwe will terminate\b|\bwalk away\b",
    "hostile": r"\b(ridiculous|outrageous|absurd|greedy|insult(ing)?|exploit(ing)?|rip.?off)\b",
    "appreciation": r"\b(appreciate|grateful|thank you|thanks|long.standing|partnership|valued?|reliable partner|fair(ness)?)\b",
    "urgency": r"\b(urgent(ly)?|asap|as soon as possible|line stop|running out|we need (it|them|the parts) by|immediately|critical shortage)\b",
    "budget": r"\b(our|the) budget (is|of|for|allows)\b|\bwe can (only )?afford\b|\bmaximum we can pay\b",
    "no_alternative": r"\b(no|without an?) (alternative|other (supplier|source)|second source)\b|\bonly supplier\b|\bwe depend on you\b",
    "competition": r"\b(other|alternative|competing|second.source) (offers?|quotes?|suppliers?|bids?)\b|\bbenchmark\b",
    "asks_breakdown": r"\b(cost )?break.?down\b|\bcost (structure|split|bridge|drivers)\b|\bcalculation\b",
    "asks_variants": r"\b(variant|alternative design|design change|cheaper (option|design|material)|value engineering)\b",
    "asks_capacity": r"\b(capacity|lead time|delivery schedule|earliest)\b",
    "asks_margin": r"\b(your )?margin\b",
}
COMPILED = {k: re.compile(v, re.I) for k, v in RULES.items()}


def read(body):
    """{feature: bool} for one e-mail, plus its length in words."""
    text = body or ""
    out = {k: bool(r.search(text)) for k, r in COMPILED.items()}
    out["leak"] = out["urgency"] or out["budget"] or out["no_alternative"]
    out["questions"] = text.count("?")
    out["words"] = len(text.split())
    return out

"""The lab's supplier in one thread: reads our e-mail, decides in value space, writes back.

Decision per message (see `persona.py` for the evidence):
1. Our best term sheet is the one worth most to the supplier. Our *step* is how much more it is
   worth than our best sheet so far - so a trade the supplier values counts as a step.
2. First counter: a fixed share of (opening value - floor), whatever we offered. Later counters:
   `mirror` times our step, plus a one-off for each verified, relevant claim, at most `cap` per
   round, never below the floor. No step from us, no move from it.
3. `agreed` when our sheet is worth at least its new ask; `final_offer` when its patience is used
   up (a tiny step counts twice) or it is at its floor.
4. After `final_offer`: meet it and it agrees; push price and it may walk; anything else holds.
The e-mail is assembled from sentences like the real suppliers' reasons.
"""

import random

from arena_kit.docs import LABELS

from .reader import read

NAMES = {f: label for label, f in LABELS.items()}
EUR_FIELDS = ("unit_price", "tooling_eur", "chargeback_eur_per_complaint")
CLAIM_TOPIC = {
    "idx": "index",
    "quote": "quote",
    "offer": "offer",
    "sc": "delivery record",
    "qn": "quality record",
    "po": "order history",
    "cost": "cost estimate",
    "fc": "volume change",
    "news": "news",
    "doc": "notice period",
    "ctr": "notice period",
}
GREET = {"family": "Guten Tag,", "corporate": "Dear Sir or Madam,", "casual": "Hallo,"}
CLOSE = {
    "family": "Viele Grüße",
    "corporate": "Mit freundlichen Grüßen",
    "casual": "Beste Grüße",
}


def fmt(field, v):
    if v is None:
        return "none"
    if field == "index_clause":
        return f"{v['series']}, {round(v['material_share'] * 100)}% material, deadband {v['deadband_pct']} %, base {v['base_month']}"
    if field in EUR_FIELDS:
        return f"{float(v):.2f}"
    if field in ("effective_date", "incoterm"):
        return str(v)
    return str(int(v))


def quote_text(persona, case, offer_id, stated, title="Angebot / Quote"):
    """A quote PDF's text in the arena's layout (the kit's `docs.quote_terms` parses it)."""
    fixed = case.get("fixed_terms", {})
    rest = {k: v for k, v in persona.pdf_standard.items() if k not in stated and k not in fixed and k in NAMES}
    lines = [persona.name, "To: Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH", f"{title} {offer_id}", "Offered terms"]
    lines += [f"{NAMES[k]} {fmt(k, v)}" for k, v in stated.items() if k in NAMES]
    lines.append("Our standard terms (apply to everything not stated above)")
    lines += [f"{NAMES[k]} {fmt(k, v)}" for k, v in rest.items()]
    lines.append("Terms fixed by your enquiry")
    lines += [f"{NAMES[k]} {fmt(k, v)}" for k, v in fixed.items() if k in NAMES]
    lines.append(f"Part(s): {', '.join(case['parts'])}. Enquiry: {case['title']}.")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def breakdown_text(persona, price):
    shares = [("Material", 0.45), ("Conversion", 0.33), ("Overhead", 0.14)]
    cost = persona.full_cost
    rows = [f"{n} | {cost * s / 0.92:.2f} | {s / 0.92 * cost / price:.0%}" for n, s in shares]
    rows.append(f"Margin | {price - cost:.2f} | {(price - cost) / price:.0%}")
    return "[Cost breakdown]\nElement | EUR per unit | Share of price\n" + "\n".join(rows)


class SupplierThread:
    def __init__(self, persona, case, rng=None, session=None):
        self.p, self.case = persona, case
        self.rng = rng or random.Random(0)
        self.session = session  # shared: claim checker, cited keys, offers of every thread
        self.key = persona.supplier_id.split(":", 1)[1]
        self.round, self.pressure, self.status, self.closed = 0, 0, "open", None
        self.ask = persona.value(case, persona.opening)
        self.a0 = self.ask
        self.mirror = persona.mirror
        self.best_ours, self.leaked, self.warm = None, False, False
        self.standing, self.messages, self.reasons = None, [], []

    # -- messages ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _mail(self, status, sheets, lines, attach=(), subject=None):
        n = len(self.messages)
        out_sheets = []
        for i, terms in enumerate(sheets):
            sid = f"offer:{self.key}-{self.round}" + ("" if i == 0 else "-a")
            out_sheets.append({"term_sheet_id": sid, "terms": terms})
            if self.session is not None:
                self.session.offers[sid] = (self.p.supplier_id, terms)
        self.standing = out_sheets[0] if out_sheets else None
        self.status = status
        attachments = []
        for kind, text in attach:
            attachments.append(
                {"attachment_id": f"att:{self.key}-{self.round}-{kind}", "name": f"{kind}.txt", "text": text}
            )
        if status in ("open", "final_offer", "agreed") and out_sheets and (status != "open" or self.round == 0):
            oid = out_sheets[0]["term_sheet_id"]
            attachments.append(
                {
                    "attachment_id": f"att:{self.key}-{self.round}-quote",
                    "name": f"quote-{oid.replace(':', '-')}.pdf",
                    "text": quote_text(self.p, self.case, oid, out_sheets[0]["terms"]),
                }
            )
        body = "\n\n".join([GREET.get(self.p.style, "Dear Sir or Madam,"), " ".join(lines)])
        body += f"\n\n{CLOSE.get(self.p.style, 'Kind regards')}\n{self.p.sender_name or self.p.name}"
        stated = set(out_sheets[0]["terms"]) if out_sheets else set()
        msg = {
            "message_id": f"msg:{self.key}-{self.round}-{n}",
            "from": self.p.sender or f"sales@{self.key}",
            "from_name": self.p.sender_name,
            "subject": subject or f"Re: {self.case['title']}",
            "body": body,
            "term_sheets": out_sheets,
            "status": status,
            "signals": {"reply_delay_days": 2, "validity_days": 7 if status == "final_offer" else 30},
            "missing_fields": sorted(set(self.case["negotiable"]) - stated) if out_sheets else [],
            "claim_results": [],
            "attachments": attachments,
            "refs": [],
            "action": None,
        }
        self.messages.append(msg)
        self.reasons.append({"round": self.round, "status": status, "ask": round(self.ask, 4), "lines": lines})
        return msg

    def opening(self):
        terms = dict(self.p.opening)
        if self.p.opening_body:
            msg = self._mail("open", [terms], [])
            msg["body"] = self.p.opening_body
            msg["subject"] = f"Quote from {self.p.name}: {self.case['title']}"
            return msg
        lines = ["Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our quote attached."]
        for series, share, change in self.p.drivers:
            lines.append(f"{series} rose {change:.1f} % in twelve months and is {share:.0%} of our cost.")
        lines.append(f"We offer €{terms['unit_price']:.2f} per unit. This offer remains valid for 30 days.")
        return self._mail("open", [terms], lines, subject=f"Quote from {self.p.name}: {self.case['title']}")

    def timeout(self):
        """Our message came too late: the offer stands, re-issued."""
        self.round += 1
        sheets = [self.standing["terms"]] if self.standing else []
        return self._mail(self.status, sheets, ["Without movement from your side we cannot move either."])

    # -- the decision --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def respond(self, msg):
        p, case = self.p, self.case
        self.round += 1
        body = msg.get("body") or ""
        feats = read(body)
        lines, attach = [], []
        tol = 0.0005 * self.a0

        # data we cited
        bonus, results = 0.0, []
        if self.session is not None:
            results = self.session.checker.check(
                p.supplier_id, body, msg.get("refs") or [], self.session.offers, self.session.used
            )
        if len(results) >= 3 and len(set(msg.get("refs") or [])) > 6:
            lines.append("We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.")
        for r in results:
            topic = CLAIM_TOPIC.get(r["kind"], "data")
            if r["result"] == "verified":
                w = p.claim_weight.get(r["kind"], 0.0)
                if w > 0:
                    bonus += w * max(0.0, self.ask - p.full_cost)
                    lines.append(f"We checked the {topic} data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"We checked the {topic} data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.")
            elif r["result"] == "duplicate":
                lines.append(f"We have already taken that {topic} data into account.")
            elif r["result"] == "irrelevant":
                lines.append(f"The {topic} data you cited does not bear on this part.")
            else:
                self.mirror *= 0.8
                self.pressure += 1
                lines.append(f"The {topic} figures you cite do not match our records.")
        r_out = [{"index": r["index"], "result": r["result"]} for r in results]

        # tone
        if feats["ultimatum"] or feats["hostile"]:
            self.mirror *= p.ultimatum
            self.pressure += 1
            lines.append("We do not negotiate under pressure; our offer reflects our costs.")
        if feats["leak"] and not self.leaked:
            self.leaked = True
            self.mirror *= p.leak
        if feats["appreciation"] and not self.warm and "family" in p.traits:
            self.warm = True
            bonus += 0.03 * max(0.0, self.ask - p.full_cost)
            lines.append("We value our long-standing cooperation.")
        if feats["asks_breakdown"]:
            if p.discloses:
                price = self.standing["terms"]["unit_price"] if self.standing else p.opening["unit_price"]
                attach.append(("cost-breakdown", breakdown_text(p, price)))
                lines.append("Please find our cost breakdown attached.")
            else:
                lines.append("Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.")
        if feats["asks_margin"] and not p.discloses:
            lines.append("Our margin and our limits stay internal.")

        sheets = [ts.get("terms", ts) for ts in msg.get("term_sheets") or []]
        if not sheets:  # a question or a holding message: the offer stands, re-issued
            terms = [self.standing["terms"]] if self.standing else []
            lines.append("Our offer stands.")
            reply = self._mail(self.status, terms, lines, attach)
            reply["claim_results"] = r_out
            return reply

        values = [p.value(case, s) for s in sheets]
        i = max(range(len(sheets)), key=values.__getitem__)
        ours, best_sheet = values[i], sheets[i]
        structure = {k: v for k, v in best_sheet.items() if k != "unit_price"}
        step = ours - self.best_ours if self.best_ours is not None else None
        self.best_ours = ours if self.best_ours is None else max(self.best_ours, ours)

        if self.status == "final_offer":
            if ours >= self.ask - tol and p.allows(best_sheet):
                reply = self._agree(best_sheet, lines, attach)
            elif step is not None and step <= tol and self.rng.random() < p.walk_on_push:
                self.closed = "walked_away"
                lines.append("We have made our final offer. We regret that we could not reach an agreement.")
                reply = self._mail("walked_away", [], lines)
            else:
                lines.append("Please note that this is our final offer. Please decide.")
                reply = self._mail("final_offer", [self.standing["terms"]], lines, attach)
            reply["claim_results"] = r_out
            return reply

        # concession
        gap = max(0.0, self.ask - p.full_cost)
        if step is None:
            concession = p.first_step * gap
            self.pressure += 1
        elif step > tol:
            concession = self.mirror * step
            self.pressure += 2 if step < p.tiny_step * self.a0 else 1
        else:
            concession = 0.0
            self.pressure += 1
            lines.append("Without movement from your side we cannot move either.")
        concession = min(concession + bonus, p.cap * self.a0)
        self.ask = max(p.full_cost, self.ask - concession)

        if ours >= self.ask - tol and p.allows(best_sheet):
            reply = self._agree(best_sheet, lines, attach)
            reply["claim_results"] = r_out
            return reply

        final = self.pressure >= p.patience or self.ask <= p.full_cost + tol
        counter = p.nearest_allowed(case, structure)
        if counter != structure:
            changed = [NAMES.get(k, k) for k in structure if counter.get(k) != structure.get(k)]
            lines.append(f"We cannot offer {', '.join(changed).lower()} as requested; we keep our standard there.")
        price = p.price_for(case, counter, self.ask)
        offer = {**counter, "unit_price": price}
        out = [offer]
        if p.alternatives and not final and (alt := self._alternative(counter)) is not None:
            out.append(alt)
        if step is not None and step > tol or step is None:
            lines.append(f"In response to your proposal we can adjust our price to €{price:.2f} per unit.")
        if len(out) > 1:
            alt_txt = ", ".join(f"{NAMES.get(k, k).lower()} {fmt(k, v)}" for k, v in out[1].items() if out[0].get(k) != v and k != "unit_price")
            lines.append(f"Alternatively, with {alt_txt}: €{out[1]['unit_price']:.2f} per unit.")
        if final:
            lines.append("Please note that this is our final offer. Please decide.")
        reply = self._mail("final_offer" if final else "open", out, lines, attach)
        reply["claim_results"] = r_out
        return reply

    def _agree(self, terms, lines, attach):
        lines.append("We accept your proposal and look forward to your order.")
        return self._mail("agreed", [dict(terms)], lines, attach)

    def _alternative(self, structure):
        """Its own preferred variant of our structure: one lever moved its way, same value to it."""
        p, case, best = self.p, self.case, None
        for f in structure:
            options = case["term_options"].get(f) or []
            for o in options:
                if o == structure[f]:
                    continue
                s = {**structure, f: o}
                if not p.allows(s):
                    continue
                price = p.price_for(case, s, self.ask)
                if price >= p.price_for(case, structure, self.ask):
                    continue  # only variants that let it offer a lower price
                gain = p.price_for(case, structure, self.ask) - price
                if best is None or gain > best[0]:
                    best = (gain, {**s, "unit_price": price})
        return best[1] if best else None

}


def _sessions():
    """The richest session per case: the kit LLM agent's if there is one."""
    best = {}
    for f in sorted(ROOT.glob("runs/*/*/*.json")):
        d = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not (d.get("state") or {}).get("result", {}).get("c_best"):
            continue
        rank = 2 if d.get("label", "").startswith("kit llm") else 1
        if rank > best.get(d["case_id"], (0, None))[0]:
            best[d["case_id"]] = (rank, d)
    return {k: v[1] for k, v in sorted(best.items())}


def _drivers(package, parts):
    if package is None:
        return []
    rows = package.query(
        f"select distinct series_id from cost_drivers where part_id in ({','.join('?' * len(parts))})", tuple(parts)
    )
    return [r["series_id"] for r in rows]


def build(package=None):
    """Scenarios from runs/, calibrated. Slow (a few seconds per case); cache with `save`."""
    out = []
    for case_id, d in _sessions().items():
        case, result = d["case"], d["state"]["result"]
        personas = {}
        for sid, opening in d["analysis"]["openings"].items():
            first = d["threads"][sid]["messages"][0]
            pdf = {k: v for k, v in opening["standard_terms"].items() if v != "none"}
            stated = opening["terms"]
            standard = closing_terms(case, {k: v for k, v in stated.items() if k != "unit_price"}, pdf)
            standard.pop("unit_price", None)
            ev = dict(EVIDENCE.get(sid, {}))
            ev.pop("notes", None)
            personas[sid] = Persona(
                supplier_id=sid,
                name=(first.get("from_name") or "").split(", ", 1)[-1] or sid,
                opening=stated,
                standard=standard,
                pdf_standard=pdf,
                sender=first.get("from", ""),
                sender_name=first.get("from_name", ""),
                opening_body=first.get("body"),
                notes=EVIDENCE.get(sid, {}).get("notes", ""),
                **ev,
            )
        reached = calibrate(case, personas, result["c_best"])
        out.append(
            Scenario(
                case=case,
                personas=personas,
                c_open=result["c_open"],
                c_best=result["c_best"],
                kind="twin",
                name=case_id.split(":", 1)[1],
                notes=f"C_best {result['c_best']:,.0f}, model {reached:,.0f}",

def save(scenarios, path=CACHE):
    rows = [

            "case": s.case,

            "drivers": s.drivers,
            "personas": {k: p.to_dict() for k, p in s.personas.items()},
        }

    ]
    path.write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

"""`uv run python -m sellm.lab <command>`

    calibrate                  rebuild sellm/lab/twins.json from runs/ (after new sessions were pulled)
    twins                      list the twins: case, suppliers, floor, C_best
    play <case> [--agent naive|llm] [--seed N] [-v]   one negotiation against a twin, printed
"""

import argparse
import json
import logging
import os

from arena_kit.cli import load_env
from arena_kit.data import DataPackage
from arena_kit.play import play

from . import twins
from .table import LocalTable


def package():
    return DataPackage(os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA", "data/package"))


def agent_for(name, pkg):
    from arena_kit.agents import LLMAgent, NaiveAgent, llm_from_env

    if name == "naive":
        return NaiveAgent()
    return LLMAgent(llm_from_env(), pkg)


def show(result, table):
    for sid, t in table.threads.items():
        print(f"--- {sid}")
        for m in t.messages:
            sheets = [s["terms"].get("unit_price") for s in m.get("term_sheets") or []]
            print(f"  supplier {m['status']:<12} {sheets}  {m['body'][:160]!r}")
    keep = ("end_reason", "deal", "supplier_id", "terms", "c_open", "c_deal", "c_best", "score")
    print(json.dumps({k: result.get(k) for k in keep}, indent=1, default=str))


def main(argv=None):
    load_env()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m sellm.lab")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("calibrate")
    sub.add_parser("twins")
    p = sub.add_parser("play")
    p.add_argument("case")
    p.add_argument("--agent", default="naive", choices=["naive", "llm"])
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO if a.verbose else logging.WARNING, format="%(message)s")

    if a.cmd == "calibrate":
        scenarios = twins.build(package())
        twins.save(scenarios)
        for s in scenarios:
            print(s.name, s.notes, {k: round(p.full_cost, 2) for k, p in s.personas.items()})
        print(f"wrote {twins.CACHE}")
    elif a.cmd == "twins":
        for s in twins.load():
            floors = {k: round(p.full_cost, 2) for k, p in s.personas.items()}
            print(f"{s.name:5} {s.case['type']:15} {s.case['buyer']['category_goal']:14} floors {floors}  {s.notes}")
    elif a.cmd == "play":
        pkg = package()
        name = a.case.split(":")[-1]
        scenario = next(s for s in twins.load() if s.name == name)
        table = LocalTable(scenario, pkg.facts, seed=a.seed)
        result = play(table, scenario.case["case_id"], agent_for(a.agent, pkg))
        show(result, table)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""How close are the twins to the real suppliers? Replay every buyer e-mail of our real sessions
(`runs/`) into the twin of its case and compare the twin's reply with the real one.

Per reply: the value of the supplier's offer to the supplier itself (so a different structure does
not count as an error), as a share of its opening value; the status (open, final_offer, agreed,
walked_away); and the claim results the twin's checker gives against the arena's. `fit` tunes the
dynamics (first step, mirror, concession limit and its decay, patience) per twin on these replays,
starting from the parameters that fit all sessions together.
"""

import copy
import itertools
import json
import random
import statistics

from .bot import SupplierThread
from .table import Session
from .twins import ROOT

GRID = {
    "first_step": [0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.65],
    "mirror": [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85],
    "cap": [0.004, 0.007, 0.01, 0.015, 0.025],
    "cap_decay": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
    "patience": [3, 4, 5, 6, 7],
}
STATUS_WEIGHT = 1.0  # a wrong status counts like 1 % of the opening value off


def real_sessions(name):
    out = []
    for f in sorted(ROOT.glob(f"runs/*/{name}/*.json")):
        d = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if (d.get("state") or {}).get("result"):
            out.append(d)
    return out


def replay(scenario, session, facts, params=None):
    """Rows, one per real supplier reply to a buyer e-mail."""
    case, rows = scenario.case, []
    shared = Session(scenario, facts)
    for sid, thread in session["threads"].items():
        persona = copy.copy(scenario.personas[sid])
        for k, v in (params or {}).items():
            setattr(persona, k, v)
        persona.alternatives = False  # the ask is what is compared; skip the slow variant search
        bot = SupplierThread(persona, case, random.Random(0), shared)
        bot.opening()
        msgs = thread["messages"]
        for i, m in enumerate(msgs):
            if m.get("from") != "buyer" or m.get("action"):
                continue
            real = next((x for x in msgs[i + 1 :] if x.get("from") != "buyer"), None)
            if real is None or bot.closed:
                break
            mine = bot.respond({"body": m.get("body", ""), "refs": m.get("refs") or [], "term_sheets": m.get("term_sheets") or []})
            a0 = bot.a0
            real_sheets = real.get("term_sheets") or []
            row = {
                "case": scenario.name,
                "session": session["session_id"],
                "label": session.get("label", ""),
                "supplier": sid,
                "round": bot.round,
                "real_status": real.get("status"),
                "twin_status": mine["status"],
                "real_claims": [c["result"] for c in real.get("claim_results") or []],
                "twin_claims": [c["result"] for c in mine.get("claim_results") or []],
            }
            if real_sheets and mine.get("term_sheets"):
                rv = persona.value(case, real_sheets[0]["terms"])
                tv = persona.value(case, mine["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
                row.update(real_price=real_sheets[0]["terms"].get("unit_price"),
                           twin_price=mine["term_sheets"][0]["terms"].get("unit_price"),
                           err_pct=100 * (tv - rv) / a0)
            rows.append(row)
    return rows


def loss(rows):
    errs = [abs(r["err_pct"]) for r in rows if "err_pct" in r]
    status = [r["real_status"] != r["twin_status"] for r in rows]
    if not rows:
        return 0.0
    return (statistics.mean(errs) if errs else 0.0) + STATUS_WEIGHT * statistics.mean(status)


def evaluate(scenarios, facts, params_for=lambda s: None):
    rows = []
    for s in scenarios:
        for session in real_sessions(s.name):
            rows += replay(s, session, facts, params_for(s))
    return rows


def fit(scenarios, facts, log=print):
    """Global grid search, then per twin a search one grid step around the global best."""
    keys = list(GRID)
    sessions = {s.name: real_sessions(s.name) for s in scenarios}

    def total(params, subset):
        rows = []
        for s in subset:
            for session in sessions[s.name]:
                rows += replay(s, session, facts, params)
        return loss(rows), rows

    best = None
    for combo in itertools.product(*(GRID[k] for k in keys)):
        params = dict(zip(keys, combo, strict=True))
        value, _ = total(params, scenarios)
        if best is None or value < best[0]:
            best = (value, params)
    log(f"global best {best[1]} loss {best[0]:.3f}")
    per = {}
    for s in scenarios:
        if not sessions[s.name]:
            per[s.name] = dict(best[1])
            continue
        near = {}
        for k in keys:
            i = GRID[k].index(best[1][k])
            near[k] = GRID[k][max(0, i - 1) : i + 2]
        local = None
        for combo in itertools.product(*(near[k] for k in keys)):
            params = dict(zip(keys, combo, strict=True))
            value, _ = total(params, [s])
            if local is None or value < local[0] - 1e-9:
                local = (value, params)
        per[s.name] = local[1]
        log(f"{s.name}: {local[1]} loss {local[0]:.3f} ({len(sessions[s.name])} sessions)")
    return best[1], per


def report(rows):
    """Markdown: error per case, status agreement, claim agreement."""
    out = ["| Case | Replies | Mean abs error (% of opening value) | Status agrees | Claims agree |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    by = {}
    for r in rows:
        by.setdefault(r["case"], []).append(r)
    for case, rs in sorted(by.items()):
        errs = [abs(r["err_pct"]) for r in rs if "err_pct" in r]
        st = sum(r["real_status"] == r["twin_status"] for r in rs)
        pairs = [(a, b) for r in rs for a, b in zip(r["real_claims"], r["twin_claims"], strict=False)]
        cl = f"{sum(a == b for a, b in pairs)}/{len(pairs)}" if pairs else "-"
        out.append(f"| {case} | {len(rs)} | {statistics.mean(errs) if errs else 0:.2f} | {st}/{len(rs)} | {cl} |")
    errs = [abs(r["err_pct"]) for r in rows if "err_pct" in r]
    st = sum(r["real_status"] == r["twin_status"] for r in rows)
    out.append(f"| **all** | {len(rows)} | **{statistics.mean(errs):.2f}** | {st}/{len(rows)} | |")
    return "\n".join(out)

"""The lab (sellm/lab): twins match their cases, the local table keeps the arena's rules, the
claim checker follows the published rules, any agent can play every twin to the end."""

import random
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from arena_kit.agents.naive import NaiveAgent
from arena_kit.client import ArenaError
from arena_kit.cost import must_haves_ok
from arena_kit.play import play
from sellm.lab import LocalTable, best_package
from sellm.lab import twins as twin_lib
from sellm.lab.bot import SupplierThread
from sellm.lab.claims import ClaimChecker

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "package" / "facts.json"
SCENARIOS = twin_lib.load()


def facts():
    if not DATA.is_file():
        pytest.skip("data package not downloaded (uv run arena data)")
    import json

    return json.loads(DATA.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("scenario", SCENARIOS, ids=lambda s: s.name)
def test_twin_reaches_c_best(scenario):
    best = min(best_package(scenario.case, p)[0] for p in scenario.personas.values())
    assert best == pytest.approx(scenario.c_best, rel=1e-4)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("scenario", SCENARIOS, ids=lambda s: s.name)
def test_naive_agent_plays_every_twin(scenario):
    for seed in range(3):
        table = LocalTable(scenario, {}, seed=seed)
        result = play(table, scenario.case["case_id"], NaiveAgent())
        assert 0.0 <= result["score"] <= 1.0
        if result["deal"]:
            persona = scenario.personas[result["supplier_id"]]
            assert persona.value(scenario.case, result["terms"]) >= persona.full_cost - 1e-6
            assert result["must_haves_ok"] == must_haves_ok(scenario.case, result["terms"])


def _p01():
    return next(s for s in SCENARIOS if s.name == "P01")


def test_table_refuses_what_the_arena_refuses():
    s = _p01()
    table = LocalTable(s, {})
    case, threads = table.open()
    sid = case["suppliers"][0]
    with pytest.raises(ArenaError) as e:  # a field missing
        table.send(sid, {"body": "x", "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 130.0}}]})
    assert e.value.status == 422
    with pytest.raises(ArenaError) as e:  # a value not in term_options
        table.send(sid, {"term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 130.0, "effective_date": "2027-02-01", "payment_days": 30}}]})
    assert e.value.status == 422
    reply = table.send(sid, {"body": "x", "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 120.0, "effective_date": "2027-01-01", "payment_days": 30}}]})
    if len(reply["term_sheets"]) > 1:  # only the first sheet is a standing offer
        with pytest.raises(ArenaError) as e:
            table.close(sid, {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": reply["term_sheets"][1]["term_sheet_id"]}})
        assert e.value.status == 422
    for _ in range(case["round_limit"] - 1):
        if table.threads[sid].closed:
            return
        table.send(sid, {"body": "x", "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 120.0, "effective_date": "2027-01-01", "payment_days": 30}}]})
    with pytest.raises(ArenaError) as e:
        table.send(sid, {"body": "x"})
    assert e.value.status == 409


def test_walk_away_scores_the_alternative():
    s = _p01()
    table = LocalTable(s, {})
    case, _ = table.open()
    result = table.close(case["suppliers"][0], {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}})
    assert result["deal"] is False
    assert result["score"] == 0.0  # P01's alternative is worse than the opening


def test_supplier_mirrors_steps_and_holds_its_final_offer():
    s = _p01()
    persona = s.personas["sup:70110"]
    bot = SupplierThread(persona, s.case, random.Random(0))
    bot.opening()
    terms = {"effective_date": "2027-01-01", "payment_days": 30}
    asks = []
    price = 120.0
    while bot.status != "final_offer":
        reply = bot.respond({"body": "", "term_sheets": [{"terms": {**terms, "unit_price": price}}]})
        asks.append(bot.ask)
        price += 1.0
    assert all(a >= b for a, b in zip(asks, asks[1:], strict=False))  # it never asks for more
    assert asks[-1] >= persona.full_cost
    standing = reply["term_sheets"][0]["terms"]
    met = bot.respond({"body": "", "term_sheets": [{"terms": standing}]})
    assert met["status"] == "agreed"


def test_claims_follow_the_published_rules():
    f = facts()
    s = _p01()
    checker = ClaimChecker(f, s.case, ["PPI-C241", "LCI-C", "PPI-D351"])
    months = sorted(k for k in f if k.startswith("idx:PPI-D351@"))[-13:]
    a, b = months[0], months[-1]
    change = (f[b]["value"] / f[a]["value"] - 1) * 100
    used = set()
    good = checker.check("sup:70110", f"Electricity {a} to {b} changed by {change:.1f} %.", used=used)
    assert [r["result"] for r in good] == ["verified"]
    again = checker.check("sup:70110", f"As {a} and {b} showed, {change:.1f} %.", used=used)
    assert [r["result"] for r in again] == ["duplicate"]
    wrong = checker.check("sup:70110", f"Between {a} and {b} it moved {change + 3:.1f} %.", used=set())
    assert [r["result"] for r in wrong] == ["contradicted"]
    unknown = checker.check("sup:70110", "See cost:999999 at EUR 10.00.", used=set())
    assert [r["result"] for r in unknown] == ["contradicted"]
    cost = checker.check("sup:70110", "Our estimate cost:310010 puts your full cost at EUR 132.64.", used=set())
    assert [r["result"] for r in cost] == ["verified"]

from sellm.lab import twins, backtest
from arena_kit.data import DataPackage
pkg = DataPackage('data/package')
sc = twins.load()
rows = backtest.evaluate(sc, pkg.facts)
table = backtest.report(rows)
floors = "\n".join(
    f"| {s.name} | {s.case['type']} / {s.case['buyer']['category_goal']} | " + ", ".join(f"{k} {p.full_cost:.2f} (opening {p.opening['unit_price']:.2f})" for k, p in s.personas.items())
    + f" | {s.c_best:,.0f} |" for s in sc)
dyn = "\n".join(
    f"| {s.name} | " + " | ".join(str(getattr(next(iter(s.personas.values())), k)) for k in ("first_step", "mirror", "cap", "cap_decay", "patience")) + " |" for s in sc)
text = f"""# Lab backtest: how close the twins are to the real suppliers

Generated Sat 2026-10-10 by `uv run python -m sellm.lab backtest` (after `--fit`). Every buyer e-mail of
our real sessions in `runs/` (practice and sandbox, {len(rows)} supplier replies) is replayed into the twin
of its case; the twin's reply is compared with the real one. Error: the value of the supplier's offer
to the supplier itself (so a different structure is not an error), as a share of its opening value.

## Accuracy

{table}

Read it like this: D01 (28 sessions) and P01, P04, P07, P08 are reproduced within about half a percent
of the opening value per reply, and the status (open / final_offer / agreed / walked_away) matches in
9 of 10 replies overall. **P05 and P10 are not**: one session each, and the RFQ job shops in P05 and
the capacity-tight seal maker in P10 concede very differently from the rest. Treat lab results on those
two as weak.

## Floors (calibrated to C_best)

The floor is the full cost in value space: the cheapest package the twin accepts costs exactly the
case's C_best. On P01 this gives 129.91; the relationship charge the arena billed on our P01 deal
implies 129.95. Where a plant-specific should-cost exists the floors sit within 3-5 % of it (P02
363.96 vs 374.95, P03 397.46 vs 403.21, P10 25.64 vs 24.31), as close as the estimate itself.

| Case | Type / goal | Floor per supplier (value at its standard terms) | C_best |
|---|---|---|---|
{floors}

## Fitted dynamics

first_step: share of (opening - floor) in the first counter; mirror: share of our step it gives back;
cap: most it gives back for our step in its 2nd counter (share of its opening value), shrinking by
cap_decay per further counter; patience: our messages until final_offer (a tiny step counts twice).
Fitted on a grid, per case one step around the global best. Cases with one session are fitted on 2-6
replies: these are plausible values, not measurements.

| Case | first_step | mirror | cap | cap_decay | patience |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
{dyn}

What it says about the real suppliers: they give back far less than our step (cap at the grid's
lowest value 0.4 % of the opening for most), so a large step buys a large concession only up to a
small limit per round - and how much room is left after five rounds is decided mostly by the first
counter. Strategies to screen follow from this; see `sellm/lab/strategies.py`.
"""
open('runs/lab/BACKTEST.md','w').write(text)
print(text[:1500])
EOF

input.content:
"""Play strategies against the lab's suppliers and rank them.

Two modes:
- `compare`: named strategies (see `strategies.registry`) on every twin and invented scenario,
  several seeds each.
- `search`: random variants of the `Calculator` knobs, successive halving - many variants on few
  scenarios, the better half on twice as many, until the time is up - plus the baselines.

The ranking is by the mean score over all scenarios. The report also shows the twins and the
invented scenarios apart, the held-out twins (P04, P10, P18 per docs/PLAN.md section 8), the worst
tenth, and every crash, broken must-have and deal worse than the opening (score 0 with a deal).
"""

import json
import math
import os
import random
import statistics
import time
import traceback
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor

from arena_kit.play import play

from . import invent, twins
from .strategies import registry, sample_knobs
from .table import LocalTable

HOLDOUT = {"P04", "P10", "P18"}
_W = {}  # per worker process: the package and the scenarios


def _init(n_invented, invent_seed):
    from arena_kit.data import DataPackage

    pkg = DataPackage(os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA", "data/package"))
    pkg.lookup("")
    scen = twins.load()
    scen += invent.generate(n_invented, scen, pkg, seed=invent_seed)
    _W.update(pkg=pkg, scenarios={s.name: s for s in scen})


def _play(job):
    """One negotiation: (strategy name, knobs, scenario name, seed) -> a result row."""
    name, knobs, scen_name, seed = job
    s = _W["scenarios"][scen_name]
    row = {"strategy": name, "knobs": knobs, "scenario": scen_name, "kind": s.kind, "seed": seed}
    try:
        agent = registry(_W["pkg"])[name](**(knobs or {}))
        r = play(LocalTable(s, _W["pkg"].facts, seed=seed), s.case["case_id"], agent)
        row.update(
            score=r["score"],
            deal=r["deal"],
            rounds=r.get("rounds"),
            end=r.get("end_reason"),
            broken=bool(r["deal"] and not r["must_haves_ok"]),
            worse=bool(r["deal"] and r["c_deal"] > r["c_open"]),
        )
    except Exception as e:  # a crash is a result too: it would cost the case in the final
        row.update(score=0.0, deal=False, crash=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200], trace=traceback.format_exc()[-600:])
    return row


def _scenario_names(n_invented, invent_seed):
    _init(n_invented, invent_seed)
    return list(_W["scenarios"]), {k: v.kind for k, v in _W["scenarios"].items()}


def compare(names, n_invented=100, seeds=3, workers=None, invent_seed=1):
    scen, _ = _scenario_names(n_invented, invent_seed)
    jobs = [(n, {}, s, seed) for n in names for s in scen for seed in range(seeds)]
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(workers, initializer=_init, initargs=(n_invented, invent_seed)) as pool:
        return list(pool.map(_play, jobs, chunksize=16))


def search(minutes=10, n_invented=150, start=64, seeds=2, workers=None, invent_seed=1, seed=0, log=print):
    """Successive halving over random Calculator knobs within `minutes`; baselines always run."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    scen, _ = _scenario_names(n_invented, invent_seed)
    rng.shuffle(scen)
    deadline = time.time() + 60 * minutes
    variants = [("calc", {})] + [("calc", sample_knobs(rng)) for _ in range(start - 1)]
    rows, size = [], max(12, len(scen) // 8)
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(workers, initializer=_init, initargs=(n_invented, invent_seed)) as pool:
        base = [(n, {}, s, k) for n in ("naive", "kit-like") for s in scen for k in range(seeds)]
        rows += list(pool.map(_play, base, chunksize=16))
        done = {}  # (name, knobs json) -> scenarios already played
        while variants and time.time() < deadline:
            subset = scen[:size]
            jobs = []
            for name, knobs in variants:
                key = (name, json.dumps(knobs, sort_keys=True))
                have = done.setdefault(key, set())
                jobs += [(name, knobs, s, k) for s in subset if s not in have for k in range(seeds)]
                have.update(subset)
            rows += list(pool.map(_play, jobs, chunksize=16))
            means = {}
            for r in rows:
                key = (r["strategy"], json.dumps(r["knobs"], sort_keys=True))
                means.setdefault(key, []).append(r["score"])
            ranked = sorted(
                variants, key=lambda v: -statistics.mean(means[(v[0], json.dumps(v[1], sort_keys=True))])
            )
            log(
                f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {len(variants)} variants on {len(subset)} scenarios; "
                f"best {statistics.mean(means[(ranked[0][0], json.dumps(ranked[0][1], sort_keys=True))]):.3f}"
            )
            if size >= len(scen):
                # all scenarios played: refill with mutations of the best, keep searching
                keep = ranked[: max(4, len(ranked) // 4)]
                variants = keep + [("calc", mutate(rng, keep[i % len(keep)][1])) for i in range(len(keep) * 3)]
            else:
                variants = ranked[: max(4, len(ranked) // 2)]
                size = min(len(scen), size * 2)
    return rows


def mutate(rng, knobs):
    """A neighbour of a variant: one or two knobs re-drawn."""
    fresh = sample_knobs(rng)
    out = dict(knobs)
    for k in rng.sample(list(fresh), rng.randint(1, 2)):
        out[k] = fresh[k]
    return out


def summarise(rows, min_scenarios=0):
    """{variant key: stats} over the rows; variants played on fewer scenarios are left out."""
    by = {}
    for r in rows:
        key = r["strategy"] + (" " + json.dumps(r["knobs"], sort_keys=True) if r["knobs"] else "")
        by.setdefault(key, []).append(r)
    out = {}
    for key, rs in by.items():
        scen = {r["scenario"] for r in rs}
        if len(scen) < min_scenarios:
            continue
        per = {}
        for r in rs:
            per.setdefault(r["scenario"], []).append(r["score"])
        means = {s: statistics.mean(v) for s, v in per.items()}
        kinds = {r["scenario"]: r["kind"] for r in rs}
        twin = [v for s, v in means.items() if kinds[s] == "twin"]
        inv = [v for s, v in means.items() if kinds[s] == "invented"]
        hold = [v for s, v in means.items() if s in HOLDOUT]
        worst = sorted(means.values())[: max(1, len(means) // 10)]
        out[key] = {
            "strategy": rs[0]["strategy"],
            "knobs": rs[0]["knobs"],
            "scenarios": len(scen),
            "mean": statistics.mean(means.values()),
            "twins": statistics.mean(twin) if twin else math.nan,
            "invented": statistics.mean(inv) if inv else math.nan,
            "holdout": statistics.mean(hold) if hold else math.nan,
            "worst10": statistics.mean(worst),
            "crashes": sum("crash" in r for r in rs),
            "broken": sum(r.get("broken", False) for r in rs),
            "worse": sum(r.get("worse", False) for r in rs),
            "no_deal": sum(not r.get("deal") for r in rs),
            "per_twin": {s: round(v, 3) for s, v in sorted(means.items()) if kinds[s] == "twin"},
        }
    return out


def report(rows, title, top=12, min_scenarios=0):
    stats = summarise(rows, min_scenarios)
    ranked = sorted(stats.values(), key=lambda x: -x["mean"])
    lines = [
        f"# {title}",
        "",
        f"{len(rows)} negotiations, {len({r['scenario'] for r in rows})} scenarios "
        f"({sum(1 for s in {(r['scenario'], r['kind']) for r in rows} if s[1] == 'twin')} twins). "
        "Scores x 100; 'worst 10 %' is the mean of the worst tenth of scenarios; crashes, broken "
        "must-haves and deals worse than the opening are counted per negotiation.",
        "",
        "| # | Strategy | Knobs | Scen. | Mean | Twins | Invented | Held-out | Worst 10 % | No deal | Crash | Broken | Worse |",
        "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for i, s in enumerate(ranked[:top], 1):
        knobs = ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted((s["knobs"] or {}).items())) or "-"
        lines.append(
            f"| {i} | {s['strategy']} | {knobs} | {s['scenarios']} | **{100 * s['mean']:.1f}** | "
            f"{100 * s['twins']:.1f} | {100 * s['invented']:.1f} | {100 * s['holdout']:.1f} | "
            f"{100 * s['worst10']:.1f} | {s['no_deal']} | {s['crashes']} | {s['broken']} | {s['worse']} |"
        )
    base = [s for s in ranked if not s["knobs"]]
    if base and ranked[0] not in base:
        lines += ["", "Baselines:", ""]
        for s in base:
            lines.append(f"- {s['strategy']}: mean {100 * s['mean']:.1f}, twins {100 * s['twins']:.1f}, invented {100 * s['invented']:.1f}")
    lines += ["", "Per twin (best three and baselines):", ""]
    show = ranked[:3] + [s for s in base if s not in ranked[:3]]
    names = sorted({t for s in show for t in s["per_twin"]})
    lines.append("| Strategy | " + " | ".join(names) + " |")
    lines.append("|---|" + "---|" * len(names))
    for s in show:
        label = s["strategy"] + (" #" + str(ranked.index(s) + 1) if s["knobs"] else "")
        lines.append(f"| {label} | " + " | ".join(f"{s['per_twin'].get(n, math.nan):.2f}" for n in names) + " |")
    crashes = [r for r in rows if "crash" in r]
    if crashes:
        lines += ["", f"Crashes ({len(crashes)}), first ones:", ""]
        for r in crashes[:5]:
            lines.append(f"- {r['strategy']} {r['scenario']}: {r['crash']}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

# Lab validation: the same agent in the lab and in the arena

Sat 2026-10-10, 16:20. The backtest (`BACKTEST.md`) replays real e-mails into the twins one by one.
This is the harder check: let an agent we have already run in the arena play the twins on its own
and compare the scores. Twins as in `sellm/lab/twins.json` after `backtest --fit` (dynamics fitted on
237 real supplier replies).

## Kit naive agent (deterministic; 5 lab seeds, all equal)

| Case | Arena | Lab |
|---|---|---|
| P01 | 0.583 | 0.590 |
| D01 | 0.200 | 0.235 |

## Kit LLM agent, OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol (one lab run per case, about 60 LLM calls)

| Case | Arena (baseline) | Lab |
|---|---|---|
| D01 | 0.786 | 0.759 |
| P01 | 0.789 | 0.814 |
| P02 | 0.105 | 0.183 |
| P03 | 0.903 | 0.935 |
| P04 | 0.810 | 0.982 |
| P05 | 0.676 | 0.479 |
| P07 | 0.779 | 0.760 |
| P08 | 0.433 | 0.451 |
| P10 | 0.570 | 0.686 |
| P11 | 0.710 | 0.398 |
| P18 | 0.377 | 0.286 |
| **Mean of the 10 practice cases** | **61.5** | **59.8** |

Mean absolute difference per practice case: 0.11. One LLM run per side, and the LLM agent itself
varies from run to run, so part of that is noise.

## How far to trust the lab

- **Good** (within about 0.03 in score): D01, P01, P03, P07, P08. The mean over the practice cases
  is within 2 points.
- **Weak**: P04, P05, P10, P11 (differences 0.12-0.31), P02 and P18 in between. P05 and P10 have
  one real session each, and P05 is an RFQ with three job shops whose concessions the model gets
  wrong by about 7 % of the opening value.
- **Not modelled**: the 60-second clock and timeouts (the lab has no clock), reply delays, the
  prose itself (the lab's supplier reads keywords and checks data, it does not understand an
  argument), and anything we have never seen a supplier do.
- Use the lab to **rank strategy variants by their mean over many scenarios** (twins plus invented
  ones). Do not read a single case's lab score as a prediction. Confirm a winner in the sandbox, then
  on one or two practice cases.

How the twins were built and how well they match: `runs/lab/BACKTEST.md`, `runs/lab/VALIDATION.md`.

- **Suppliers price levers at their own cost** (seen in their alternative sheets): payment days at
  about 6.5 % a year for groups (P02, P08), about 9 % for a family foundry (D01), about 35 % for a

  about a third of (opening - floor), later ones a share of our step but at most about 0.3-0.6 % of
  the opening per round, final offer around our 6th message. So the first counter and the number of

## Was ich gemacht habe

1. **Einrichtung:** Python 3.12 und das Datenpaket installiert. In deiner `.env` habe ich einen Fehler behoben: Dort wurde Anthropic mit leerem Key geladen, und der LLM-Agent wäre ohne Fehlermeldung auf den naiven Agenten zurückgefallen. Jetzt läuft OpenAI, getestet.
2. **Ein lokales Lab (`sellm/lab/`), das die Arena-Supplier nachbildet.** Es gibt 15 Nachbauten ("Twins") der Supplier aus unseren 12 gespielten Fällen. Jeder Agent spielt dagegen wie gegen die echte Arena, nur kostenlos und in Millisekunden.
3. **Backtest gegen die Realität.** Alle 237 echten Supplier-Antworten aus unseren Sessions habe ich in die Twins eingespielt und die Parameter angepasst:
   - Im Schnitt liegt der Twin 0,79 % neben der echten Antwort.
   - Der Status (offen, `final_offer`, `agreed`) stimmt in 218 von 237 Fällen.
4. **Gegencheck im geschlossenen Kreis** mit Agenten, deren echte Ergebnisse wir kennen:

   | Agent | Lab | Arena |
   |---|---|---|
   | Naiver Agent, P01 | 0,59 | 0,58 |
   | LLM-Agent des Kits, Mittel der 10 Practice-Fälle | 59,8 | 61,5 |

   Kosten: etwa 60 LLM-Aufrufe auf deinem Key.
5. **Turnier:** Dazu kommen erfundene Supplier, gebaut aus echten Firmen im Datenpaket auf abgewandelten Fällen. Dazu eine regelbasierte Strategie mit 14 Stellschrauben und ein Suchlauf, der automatisch die beste Kombination sucht.
6. Alles ist geloggt, mit 30 neuen Tests (61 grün) in 5 Commits.

## Was es uns bringt

- **Strategien testen ohne Quota.** Tausende Verhandlungen pro Minute statt einer Practice-Session pro Versuch. Die 189 Versuche sind nur noch für den Gegencheck da.
- **Erste Messung:** Die regelbasierte Strategie kommt auf **48,7**, der naive Kit-Agent auf **36,4**. Das ist über 12 Twins und 60 erfundene Fälle gemittelt, also nicht mit der echten Baseline von 61,5 vergleichbar.
- **Fehler, die uns im Finale Punkte gekostet hätten, findet das Lab vorher.** Der naive Agent hat 10-mal eine Pflichtbedingung verletzt. Meine Strategie hat Deals angenommen, die teurer waren als das Startangebot und damit 0 Punkte bringen. Das ist jetzt durch eine Schutzregel verhindert.

## Die wichtigsten Erkenntnisse

1. **Die Untergrenze eines Suppliers sind seine echten Vollkosten, und `C_best` verrät sie.** Für P01 ergibt sich so 129,91 €. Aus dem Beziehungsabschlag, den die Arena völlig unabhängig berechnet hat, folgen 129,95 €. Unsere Should-Cost-Schätzungen liegen innerhalb von 3–5 % davon, sie taugen also als Ziel.
2. **Der LLM-Agent des Kits hat 1–31 % über dieser Untergrenze abgeschlossen.** Am meisten Luft war bei P10 (31 %), P18 (20 %) und P08 (10 %), also genau dort, wo wir am schlechtesten waren.
3. **Supplier geben pro Runde wenig nach, egal wie groß unser Schritt ist.** Das Erste Gegenangebot und die Zahl der genutzten Runden entscheiden das meiste.
4. **Supplier bewerten Hebel zu ihren eigenen Kosten:**
   - Zahlungsziel: Konzerne rechnen mit etwa 6,5 % Kapitalkosten pro Jahr, der Lohnfertiger in P05 mit etwa 35 %. Bei ihm ist schnelle Zahlung ein billiger Trumpf für uns.
   - Lieferzeit: etwa 0,15 € pro Tag und Stück bei P10.
5. **Nur bestimmte Daten wirken, je nach Supplier.** Kündigungsfrist, Mengenänderung, Qualitätsdaten und Rivalen-Angebote haben bewegt, andere wurden "verified, but does not change our calculation". Außerdem: Brief und Vertrag zählen für die Arena als *ein* Argument.

Grenzen: Bei P05 und P10 ist das Lab schwach, es hat keine 60-Sekunden-Uhr, und es versteht keine Argumente, sondern liest Stichworte. Ergebnisse aus dem Lab sind Hypothesen, bis die Sandbox oder ein Practice-Fall sie bestätigt.

## Was sonst los ist

- **Jonathan** hat 33 kostenlose Sandbox-Tests gemacht:
  - Nur das erste Blatt einer Mail kann angenommen werden.
  - `final_offer` ist endgültig.
  - Supplier spiegeln unsere Schrittgröße.
  - RFQs brauchen eine Schleife pro Thread.

  Außerdem holt sich die Arena-CLI jetzt vor jedem Lauf automatisch den neuesten Code. Seine Ergebnisse stecken schon im Lab-Modell.
- **Auf deinem Rechner fehlt der `ARENA_API_KEY`.** Sandbox und Practice gehen von hier aus erst, wenn du ihn von Jonathan bekommst und in `.env` einträgst. Die Quota laut `STATUS.md`: 189 übrig, nachprüfen kann ich das ohne Key nicht.
- **Noch offen fürs Team:** Welcher Rechner spielt das Finale, wer übernimmt welchen Arbeitsbereich, und das Datenpaket von Sonntag 08:00.

## Wie du testen würdest

**Am einfachsten sagst du mir: "Teste 1h verschiedene Strategien."** Dann:
1. starte ich `search --minutes 60` im Hintergrund,
2. lese die Zwischenergebnisse,
3. baue eigene neue Strategien ein (Ideen: Schritte genau auf die Grenze des Suppliers abstimmen, Präferenz-Sonde mit drei Paketen, Untergrenze aus dem Verlauf hochrechnen),
4. lasse sie gegeneinander antreten,
5. und am Ende kommt ein Bericht mit Log, Commit und Push.

**Selbst im Terminal:**
```bash
uv run python -m sellm.lab play P01 --agent calc       # eine Verhandlung gegen den P01-Twin ansehen
uv run python -m sellm.lab compare naive calc          # Strategien auf allen Twins + erfundenen Fällen vergleichen
uv run python -m sellm.lab search --minutes 60         # 1 h automatische Suche nach der besten Strategie
uv run python -m sellm.lab backtest                    # wie genau sind die Twins gerade?
```
Jeder Lauf schreibt einen Bericht nach `runs/lab/<zeit>-<modus>/report.md`.

Kommen neue echte Sessions dazu, etwa von Jonathan, machen `calibrate` und dann `backtest --fit --write` die Twins genauer. Das sollte nach jedem neuen Practice-Lauf passieren.

content.text:
## Was der 10-Minuten-Lauf macht

1. **Vorbereitung:** Auf jedem der 8 CPU-Kerne werden die 12 Twins geladen und 150 erfundene Fälle erzeugt, zusammen 162 Szenarien.
2. **Baseline:** Der naive Kit-Agent spielt alle 162 Szenarien, jeweils zweimal mit unterschiedlichem Zufall.
3. **64 Strategie-Varianten:** Die Standardeinstellung plus 63 zufällige Kombinationen der 14 Stellschrauben, zum Beispiel Startgebot, Schrittzahl, 1–3 Pakete pro Mail, Verhalten nach `final_offer`, Datenargumente und Ton.
4. **Aussieben in Runden:** Alle 64 spielen erst 20 Szenarien, die bessere Hälfte dann 40, davon wieder die Hälfte 80 und so weiter, bis alle 162 erreicht sind. Danach werden die besten Varianten leicht abgewandelt, jeweils ein oder zwei Stellschrauben geändert, und weiter getestet, bis die 10 Minuten um sind.
5. **Ergebnis:** Eine Rangliste mit Mittelwert, Twins und erfundenen Fällen getrennt, den zurückgehaltenen Kontrollfällen P04, P10 und P18, den schlechtesten 10 %, Abstürzen, verletzten Pflichtbedingungen und Deals über dem Startangebot.

**Wie lange noch:** Er läuft seit 7½ Minuten. Die Zeit wird nur zwischen den Runden geprüft, also ist er in etwa 3–6 Minuten fertig.

## Hintergrund und gleichzeitig weiterarbeiten

- **Ja, alles läuft im Hintergrund**, auch ein 1-Stunden-Lauf. Der Chat bleibt frei, und ich bekomme automatisch Bescheid, wenn der Lauf fertig ist.
- **Ich kann währenddessen weiterarbeiten**: Code schreiben, Ergebnisse auswerten, Doku pflegen. Das ist sinnvoll, mit zwei Einschränkungen:
  - Der Lauf belegt alle 8 Kerne. Ein zweiter schwerer Lauf parallel würde beide bremsen, leichte Arbeit stört nicht.
  - Der Lauf testet den Code-Stand von seinem Start. Was ich danach ändere, kommt erst im nächsten Lauf an. Das schreibe ich in jeden Bericht.
- **Wichtig:** Hängt der Lauf an dieser Claude-Sitzung und du schließt sie, stirbt er mit. Für 1-Stunden-Läufe starte ich ihn deshalb mit `nohup`; dann läuft er unabhängig weiter und schreibt seinen Bericht trotzdem.

## Sind die Tests perfekt?

Nein. Sie sind ehrlich gemessen ziemlich nah dran, im Mittel 59,8 gegen 61,5 beim LLM-Agenten, aber mit klaren Lücken. Was sie besser machen würde, nach Nutzen sortiert:

1. **Jeden Twin als ganze Familie plausibler Varianten statt als einen einzigen Bot.** Viele Parameter beruhen auf 1–2 echten Sessions. Eine Strategie sollte gegen alle plausiblen Varianten gut sein und nicht gegen meine eine Schätzung. Das schützt am stärksten vor Überanpassung, ist günstig und dauert ungefähr eine Stunde Arbeit.
2. **Gezielte, kostenlose Sandbox-Tests für die unsicheren Parameter**, im Stil von Jonathans Proben. Zum Beispiel: Wie viel gibt ein Supplier maximal pro Runde nach? Was bewirkt ein Datenargument genau? Jede echte Session macht die Twins genauer; danach `calibrate` und `backtest --fit`.
3. **Eine Uhr im Lab:** 60-Sekunden-Regel, Antwortzeiten von 30–60 s und die 8-Minuten-Grenze pro Welle. Damit lässt sich der Runner für das Finale testen, also RFQ-Threads parallel und rechtzeitiges Schließen. Im Moment kann das nur die echte Arena.
4. **Ein LLM als Leser der Supplier.** Heute reagiert der Supplier auf Stichworte, versteht aber kein Argument. Ein kleines, billiges Modell könnte Ton, Argumentqualität und verratene Infos bewerten. Das ist realistischer für LLM-Strategien, kostet aber Geld und Zeit pro Verhandlung. Für die regelbasierte Strategie bringt es wenig.
5. **Die übrigen Practice-Fallakten** (P06, P09, P12–P17, P19) als Vorlage für erfundene Fälle. Sie sind kostenlos lesbar, brauchen aber den `ARENA_API_KEY`.
6. **Gewinner aus dem Lab immer in der Sandbox bestätigen**, dann auf 1–2 Practice-Fällen. Dieser Schritt bleibt Pflicht, egal wie gut das Lab wird.

Mein Vorschlag: Sobald der Lauf fertig ist, werte ich ihn aus und baue danach Punkt 1. Dann kannst du jederzeit "teste 1h" sagen, und die Ergebnisse sind belastbarer. Für Punkt 2, 5 und 6 brauchen wir den API-Key von Jonathan.
